purpose: Evaluate a prospective Pennsylvania vendor against caller-defined entity-type, registered-county, and minimum-formation-age rules using one public registry lookup.

decision_policy.proceed: Unique strong registry entity satisfies all caller-supplied type, county, and age rules.
decision_policy.human_review: Any caller policy fails or required registry evidence is uncertain/incomplete.

claim_boundaries: proceed means only that configured caller policy checks passed
it is not legal/compliance approval or proof of good standing, ownership, authority, local operations, tax situs, fraud risk, sanctions status, or creditworthiness
